description: Form 8582-CR Part III: a $5,000 rehabilitation credit from a rental (no active participation needed), wages $210,000, no passive income. Line 24 = min(25,000, 50% x (250,000 − 210,000)) = 20,000 = line 26; line 27 = tax on 194,250 ($39,467) less tax on 174,250 ($34,667) = 4,800; line 30 = min(5,000, 4,800) = $4,800 allowed, $200 carried. Form 3800 allows the $4,800 (line 16 = 39,467 − 31,694 = 7,773).
